name: Masala Omelette
steps: Finely chop the onion, tomato, green chili and coriander.
Whisk 2 eggs with a pinch of salt and turmeric, then stir in the chopped vegetables.
Heat a little oil in a pan on medium heat and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook for 2 minutes until the edges set, flip, and cook 1 more minute.
Fold and serve hot with toast or chutney.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Mix 1 cup flour, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt.
In another bowl whisk 1 cup milk, 1 egg and 2 tbsp melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir just until combined — a few lumps are fine.
Cook ¼ cup batter at a time on a buttered pan until bubbles appear, then flip.
Serve with honey, maple syrup or fruit.

name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast two slices of bread until golden.
Mash a ripe avocado with a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado on the toast.
Top with chili flakes (and a fried egg if you are not vegan).

name: Kanda Poha
steps: Rinse 2 cups of poha in a strainer, drain, and set aside for 5 minutes.
Fry a handful of peanuts in oil until crunchy, then remove.
In the same oil add mustard seeds and curry leaves, then the chopped onion and diced potato. Cook until soft.
Add turmeric, salt and a pinch of sugar, then the poha. Mix gently and steam for 2 minutes with the lid on.
Finish with the peanuts and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Overnight Oats
steps: Mix ½ cup oats, ½ cup milk and ¼ cup yogurt in a jar.
Stir in a spoon of honey.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Top with sliced banana in the morning and enjoy cold.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cooked rice that has cooled (yesterday's leftover rice is perfect).
Heat oil on high heat and fry chopped garlic and onion for 1 minute.
Add diced carrot, peas and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Add the rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce, tossing until every grain is hot and coated.
Season with pepper and serve.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water until al dente. Save a cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently cook sliced garlic in ¼ cup olive oil until pale golden.
Add chili flakes, then the drained pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss for a minute until glossy, then add chopped parsley and serve.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta until al dente and drain.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt and pepper and simmer for 8–10 minutes until saucy.
Stir in the cream and grated cheese, then the pasta.
Finish with fresh basil.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds.
Arrange them alternately on a plate with basil leaves in between.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Rinse 1 cup lentils and pressure-cook (or simmer) with 3 cups water, turmeric and salt until soft.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, then chopped garlic, ginger and green chili.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then the tomato until it turns soft.
Pour this tadka into the cooked lentils and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with rice or roti.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Fry cumin seeds in oil, then add finely chopped onion and cook until brown.
Add garlic, ginger and green chili, then the chopped tomatoes. Cook until oil separates.
Add turmeric, garam masala and salt.
Add cooked or canned chickpeas with ½ cup water and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few.
Serve with rice, roti or bread.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook chopped onion, tomato, garlic and ginger in butter until soft, then blend to a smooth puree.
Return the puree to the pan with chili powder, garam masala, salt and a pinch of sugar.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 3 more minutes.
Serve with naan or rice.

name: Jeera Aloo
steps: Boil, peel and cube 3 potatoes.
Heat oil and add 1 tsp cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add chopped green chili, then the potatoes, turmeric and salt.
Fry for 5 minutes until lightly crisp, then garnish with coriander.

name: Home-Style Chicken Curry
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, turmeric, chili powder and salt for 15 minutes.
Brown sliced onions in oil, then add garlic and ginger.
Add chopped tomatoes and garam masala and cook until thick.
Add the chicken and cook on medium heat for 20–25 minutes, covered, until tender.
Serve with rice or roti.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the chicken thinly and toss with a little cornstarch and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil for 4–5 minutes until cooked, then set aside.
Fry garlic and ginger, then add the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss until glossy.
Serve over rice or noodles.

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss chicken pieces and potato wedges with olive oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice, herbs, salt and pepper.
Spread on a tray and roast for 30–35 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Squeeze over more lemon before serving.

name: Cheesy Bean Quesadilla
steps: Mash the beans with a pinch of chili powder.
Spread the beans over half of a tortilla, then add chopped onion, bell pepper and grated cheese.
Fold and cook in a lightly oiled pan for 2–3 minutes per side until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Veggie Tacos
steps: Cook the beans and corn with cumin, chili powder and salt for 5 minutes.
Dice the tomato and onion and slice the avocado.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill each tortilla with beans and corn, top with tomato, onion and avocado, and squeeze over lime.

name: Guacamole
steps: Mash 2 ripe avocados with a fork.
Mix in finely chopped tomato, onion and coriander.
Season with lime juice and salt.
Serve with chips, tacos or toast.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop the cucumber and tomatoes into chunks and thinly slice the onion.
Add the olives and crumble the feta on top.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle oregano and a pinch of salt, and toss gently.

name: Classic Hummus
steps: Blend cooked chickpeas, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp tahini.
Add 2–3 tbsp cold water and blend until very smooth.
Season with salt and cumin.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with veggies or pita.

name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry 2 tbsp green curry paste in a little oil for 1 minute.
Pour in a can of coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add tofu cubes, broccoli and bell pepper and cook for 8–10 minutes.
Season with salt and a pinch of sugar, and serve with rice.

name: Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Whisk 3 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, grated garlic, a pinch of sugar and a little hot water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and grated carrot.
Top with chili flakes and serve warm or cold.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
steps: Cook chopped onion, garlic and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add 6 chopped tomatoes and 2 cups of water, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with toast.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: In a large mug mix 4 tbsp flour, 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp cocoa, ¼ tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt.
Stir in 3 tbsp milk and 2 tbsp melted butter until smooth.
Microwave for 70–90 seconds until risen and just set.
Let it cool for a minute and enjoy (great with ice cream).

name: Banana Smoothie
steps: Add a banana, 1 cup milk, ½ cup yogurt and 1 tsp honey to a blender.
Add a few ice cubes and blend until smooth.
Pour and serve immediately.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk 2 eggs, ½ cup milk, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of cinnamon.
Dip each slice of bread in the mixture for a few seconds on each side.
Cook in a buttered pan for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with honey, syrup or fruit.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of two slices of bread.
Put cheese between the slices with the buttered sides facing out.
Cook in a pan on medium-low heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook sliced onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft, then add garlic, cumin and paprika.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes into a thick sauce.
Make small wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5–7 minutes until the whites are set. Serve with bread.

name: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend 1 cup chopped mango, 1 cup yogurt, ½ cup milk and 1–2 tbsp sugar.
Add a pinch of cardamom and a few ice cubes and blend again.
Serve chilled.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble 2 eggs in hot oil, then push them aside.
Add chopped garlic and onion and fry for 1 minute.
Add the cold cooked rice and soy sauce and toss on high heat for 3 minutes.
Mix with the eggs, season with pepper and serve.
